# PrepBuddy

> 1-on-1 mentorship for India's JEE (Main + Advanced) and NEET UG aspirants. Every student is paired with a dedicated topper-mentor — an IITian for JEE, an AIIMS or top medical-college student for NEET — who builds a personalized study plan from real mock scores and runs daily accountability check-ins.

PrepBuddy is not a coaching institute. It does not teach syllabus content, run batches, or replace NCERT/coaching. It replaces the missing layer between content and results: a mentor who plans your week, watches your mocks, catches recurring errors, and keeps you consistent. Students typically use PrepBuddy alongside their existing self-study or coaching.

## Core facts

- Audience: Class 11, Class 12, and Droppers preparing for JEE or NEET UG in India.
- Mentors: JEE mentors are IITians; NEET mentors are AIIMS or top medical-college students. Every mentor passes a 4-stage selection (application, subject screener, mock mentoring session, final interview).
- Format: 1-on-1 (never batches). Daily short check-ins + one deeper weekly review call. Plans are rebuilt weekly from the student's real mock scores.
- Base: Hyderabad, India. Mentorship is delivered fully online, nationwide.

## Pricing (INR)

- 3-day trial: ₹99. One mentor call, a personalized 3-day plan built from the last mock, daily check-ins.
- 1-hour 1:1 session: ₹999. Second-opinion / one-topic strategy call, no ongoing plan required.
- 1 month mentorship: ₹1,599.
- 3 months mentorship: ₹3,999.
- 6 months mentorship: ₹5,999.
- Cancellation: students can cancel any ongoing plan at any time. Mentor re-match is offered before cancellation.
